messages:
maria.c: Heads up — noticed autoscaler started placing GPU pods into Pending in the canary cluster after the network module rollout. Rolling this thread for visibility.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished: network-v2 @ v2.1.0 -> infra/canary (duration 6m).

raj: Seeing a bunch of pods stuck Pending in us-west-2. Node groups created but nodes not joining due to missing subnet tags (our node-labeling relies on tag 'redwood:gpu=true').

maria.c: Confirmed root cause — tf module change converted subnet_tag_map from map(string) -> list(object) and our GitOps overlay applied the new structure but downstream code that sets tags on aws_subnet wasn't updated, so tag got omitted.

maria.c: Example of change that slipped in:
```
# old (works)
variable "subnet_tag_map" { type = map(string) }
resource "aws_subnet" "s" {
  tags = var.subnet_tag_map
}
# new (list object) -- accidentally left tag mapping out
variable "subnet_tag_map" { type = list(object({ id = string })) }
resource "aws_subnet" "s" {
  # tags computed differently, missing redwood:gpu
}
```

leila: Oof. Can we hotfix in gitops? Our release gating only pins semver, so we can push v2.1.1 with the tag restoration.

ken: Pushed hotfix branch and opened PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-modules/pull/482 — adds explicit `redwood:gpu = true` fallback and preserves old map compatibility via a small shim.

maria.c: Running terragrunt plan against canary now. If plan looks clean I'll merge and trigger canary rollout. Will also run `tf-validate` pipeline locally to catch type mismatches next time. :eyes:

raj: Also flagging billing: due to node provisioning fallback we spilled into on-demand AZs for ~30m — saw ~$120/hr increase. Logging under cost-alerts.

infra-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1123: subnet-tag-omission -> gpu-pod-pending. Pager duty: infra-oncall.

leila: Suggest we add a policy test in the terraform CI: check that any subnet resource has tag `redwood:gpu` when module is used with gpu=true. Also add an automated rollback gate to GitOps if canary nodes fail join checks for >5min.

ken: Agreed. I'll add a tiny integration test in terratest that runs in the pipeline and a preflight k8s probe to fail canary rollout early. Will include changelog note.

maria.c: Good plan. Merging hotfix in 5m if CI green. After that we'll promote v2.1.1 and run a small soak to validate no more Pending pods. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
